s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral visual disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Blurry vision in the right eye for several months
Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid in the right eye
Epiretinal membrane in the left eye
key_facts: 65-year-old woman
Blurry vision in the right eye for several months
History of bilateral iritis
Amblyopia in the left eye
Bilateral posterior chamber intraocular lens
Left-sided mastectomy 2.5 years prior
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Visual acuity: 20/25 OD and 20/150 OS
Normal intraocular pressures
Conjunctival injection and keratic precipitates in the right eye
Cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea in the right eye
Epiretinal membrane in the left eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders
Unremarkable computed tomography of the chest

shortlist.label: Intermediate Uveitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of recurrent bilateral iritis and current signs of intraocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of cystoid macular edema and keratic precipitates, which can be associated with sarcoidosis

shortlist.label: Birdshot Chorioretinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral visual disturbance and signs of intraocular inflammation, consistent with birdshot chorioretinopathy

shortlist.label: Fuchs Heterochromic Iridocyclitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of recurrent iritis and presence of keratic precipitates, which can be seen in Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis

shortlist.label: Chronic Idiopathic Uveitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent episodes of uveitis without a clear underlying cause, fitting the diagnosis of chronic idiopathic uveitis

raw.rationale: The patient's history of recurrent bilateral iritis, presence of keratic precipitates, and cystoid macular edema, along with normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Intermediate Uveitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings such as vitritis or peripheral inflammation

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal chest CT and lack of other systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Birdshot Chorioretinopathy
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic birdshot lesions in the retina

rejected.label: Fuchs Heterochromic Iridocyclitis
rejected.why: No mention of heterochromia or characteristic iris atrophy
